annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国土交通省 (Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, formerly Ministry of Construction)
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets road occupancy fees for development roads collected by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism.
Annex table lists fee amounts by facility type and land-class area.
Includes a fee line for 'automated operation support facilities' (wires detected by automated driving devices).
Specifies collection timing, refund rules, late fees at 10.75% per year, and delegation to the Hokkaido Development Bureau.
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance (1967, as amended through December 2025) on occupancy fees and related charges for development roads. It sets fee amounts, collection methods, late charges and delegation. An annex fee line covers automated operation support facilities for automated driving devices, its only link to embodied AI.

annotation.title_en: Ordinance on the Collection of Occupancy Fees etc. for Development Roads
